data_objects.name: encoded_passenger_features
data_objects.meaning: Passenger-level feature records in which travel class, demographic, fare, embarkation, title, and companionship attributes are represented primarily by numeric codes.

variables.name: Sex
variables.meaning: Numeric code for passenger sex; the code-to-category mapping is not stated.

variables.name: Age
variables.meaning: Numeric age category or transformed age feature rather than a plainly labeled raw age; category boundaries are not stated.

variables.name: Fare
variables.meaning: Numeric fare category or transformed fare feature; category boundaries and currency are not stated.

variables.name: Embarked
variables.meaning: Numeric code for embarkation location; the codebook is not stated.

variables.name: Title
variables.meaning: Numeric code for a passenger title category; the codebook is not stated.

variables.name: IsAlone
variables.meaning: Binary-coded indicator of whether the passenger traveled alone; the code-to-status mapping is not stated.

variables.name: Age*Pclass
variables.meaning: Numeric combined feature labeled from Age and Pclass; its construction is not explicitly documented.

structure.description: Each row represents one passenger-level collection of encoded attributes.
Sex, Age, Fare, Embarked, Title, and IsAlone use numeric representations whose category mappings are not contained in the table.

uncertainties: The categorical codebooks, bin boundaries, fare currency, and exact construction of Age*Pclass are not supplied.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels and encoded values visible in train.csv.
